examples.title: Description list
examples.description: Key–value metadata pairs in the default stacked layout.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { DescriptionList } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import type { DescriptionListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const items: DescriptionListItem[] = [
    { term: 'Component', definition: 'DescriptionList' },
    { term: 'Status', definition: 'Stable' },
    { term: 'Version', definition: '1.0.0' },
    { term: 'License', definition: 'MIT' },
    { term: 'Maintainer', definition: 'Cinder team' },
  ];
</script>

<DescriptionList {items} />

examples.title: Description list rich definitions
examples.description: Definitions can render rich snippet content when plain text is not enough.
examples.code: {#snippet runIdDefinition()} abc-123 {/snippet} {#snippet statusDefinition()} Active {/snippet}

examples.title: Description list variants
Description list formatted values
examples.description: A shortened ID with a copy button, a timestamp with the exact time on hover, and read-only tags with an Add a tag action.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { DescriptionList } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
  import type { DescriptionListItem } from '@lostgradient/cinder';

  const items: DescriptionListItem[] = [
    { term: 'Run ID', definition: { type: 'identifier', value: '3f2b9c1a-7d4e-4a86-9b0c-1e5d6f7a8b90' } },
    { term: 'Started', definition: { type: 'timestamp', value: '2026-10-30T14:15:07Z' } },
    {
      term: 'Tags',
      definition: { type: 'tags', tags: ['billing', 'nightly'], systemTagCount: 3, onAddTag: () => {} },
    },
  ];
</script>

<DescriptionList {items} variant="two-column" />
